schema_notes: FurnitureLAB catalogue. Each entry: an in-room object (non-electrical, non-signal-bearing) that contributes equivalent absorption area A_obj into the room's Sabine/Eyring/ray-trace physics. Schema authored by Lin (docs-writer, catalogue sub-hat) and reviewed by Dr. Chen against ISO 354 measurement discipline. Reliability tag is non-negotiable: 'measured' (cited ISO 354 lab or peer-reviewed lab), 'derived' (calculated from a parent A_obj or surface-area×alpha mapping with a documented derivation), 'estimated' (engineering judgement; UI badges amber, report flags 'low-confidence'). citation.estimated mirrors reliability for serializer convenience.

citation.reference: Beranek L L, Hidaka T. Acoustical absorption by audiences and seats. JASA 104(6) 3169-3177. Per-seat A_obj derived from area-based alpha (medium upholstered audience, occupied) times nominal seat footprint 0.275 m^2.
citation.measurement_method: ISO 354 reverberation-room method (source publication); per-seat A_obj is a derivation, not a direct measurement.
citation.notes: Phase 0 placeholder. Phase 1 substitutes direct per-seat ISO 354 numbers from Beranek 2nd ed. (2004) Table 7.2 row 1 once verified against the original printed table.
